description: Welcome! As team lead, I guide our project on "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," exploring how storytelling, design, and media bring forgotten spaces back to life. I bring leadership, media strategy, and creative direction to our team. Looking for teammates in visual design, content creation, research, and media production to build a compelling narrative together. Join us to turn hidden stories into powerful media!
summary: Our project is an interactive 3D Solar System Explorer that models planets and focuses on historical lunar and Martian missions, such as Clementine and Mariner 9. Addressing the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten," the project brings overlooked historical spacecraft back into focus. Instead of letting past probes be forgotten, it accurately reconstructs them in 3D and pairs them with interactive Scientific and Storytelling modes to highlight their legacy. This project is important because it preserves space heritage by honoring inactive missions and orbiters drifting in space or resting on planetary surfaces. Furthermore, it serves as an educational tool, turning complex space history and orbital mechanics into an engaging, accessible browser experience that inspires curiosity and keeps the history of space exploration alive.
details:
The 3D Solar System Explorer is an interactive web-based 3D application that lets users visualise and explore the Sun, major planets, Earth's Moon, and various historic spacecraft and Mars missions. Developed using HTML. The application works by rendering a 3D space scene featuring procedural textures, lighting, orbit paths, and custom-coded 3D geometric models of spacecraft like the Clementine orbiter, Lunar Prospector, GRAIL, Explorer 35, and the Spirit Rover. Users can navigate the solar system using intuitive mouse controls, toggle orbit lines, pause or resume the simulation, adjust orbit speeds, and focus the camera on specific celestial bodies or missions.

The project aims to serve as an engaging educational tool and digital archive. Its key benefits include immersive 3D navigation, detailed planetary statistics, and a dedicated scientific and storytelling documentary mode. The team focused on user experience, visual fidelity using procedural texturing, and accurate representation of historic space probes.
